O.outcome_detail: Generating position-time and velocity-time graphs for free-fall motion

cells.quote: Specifically, they successfully generated position-time and velocity-time graphs for free fall scenarios and calculated the falling time of an object using its initial position and velocity.
cells.note: The study reports successful performance but includes no comparison condition or comparative effect estimate.

O.outcome_detail: Performance on written explanations of a free-fall Python program

cells.quote: Overall, more than 75% of the students achieved at least a Moderate proficiency, with 45% reaching the Outstanding level.
cells.note: The study reports descriptive rubric performance after a didactic sequence but does not provide a comparison condition, so no treatment-versus-comparison direction can be coded.
